# Goody — account brief

## Who

Goody is a gifting platform for sending personal and business gifts without needing an address ([source](https://ongoody.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the company as Goody at ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in `ongoody/goody-app` ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` pins react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 11 public repos and 64 followers ([source](https://github.com/ongoody)).
- `ongoody/goody-app` was last pushed 2026-07-29 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app)).
- The App Store listing has 5,400 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)).
- There were 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@ongoody-maintainer-1), top contributor to `ongoody/goody-app` with 96 commits ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)). Their GitHub profile lists company "Goody" and website https://ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@ongoody-maintainer-2), top contributor to `ongoody/goody-app` with 40 commits ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-2)). Their GitHub profile lists company "Goody" and website https://ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-2)).
- @ongoody-maintainer-3, top contributor to `ongoody/goody-app` with 12 commits ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-3)).

## Why now

`ongoody/goody-app` was last pushed 2026-07-29 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app)), and the app shipped 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)). The repo runs react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One, you have 96 commits in `ongoody/goody-app`, the most of any contributor ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)). The repo has an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside CI workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the app shipped 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)). How is the work split between those workflows and EAS when you cut one of those releases?
